  1. Here's what you need to know to cast your ballot this election season

    Early absentee voting has begun and will be available until Thursday, Oct. 29. Learn more...

  2. Public workshop planned on proposed change to growth boundary

    The change is needed to allow for the development of a VA hospital on Kittredge Road near Hogan Road... Learn more ...

  3. Bangor Police Host RAD Class

    The Bangor Police Department is hosting a three-day Rape Aggression Defense (RAD) Classes. Read on...

  4. Students visit Bangor treatment plan to learn how wastewater is treated

    Students from Holbrook Middle School in Holden arrived by canoe, led by the Penobscot River Keepers.... Read on...

  5. Major infrastructure work will require closure of Cumberland Street

    The work also will result in Harlow Street being closed for a time, beginning Monday, Sept. 21. Learn more...

  6. Bangor City Clerk receives top award for her service to residents

    The Maine Town & City Clerks' Association named Lisa Goodwin as winner of its Lighthouse Award. Learn more...

  7. Pelletier named new Chief of Bangor Fire Department

    He had served as deputy fire chief of one of the largest fire department's in the state since 2018. Learn more...

  8. Bangor Police update Online Reporting System

    Crimes can be reported that don't need immediate officer assistance, such as late reports of theft. Read on...

  9. Tax relief options are available to eligible Bangor property owners

    The City and the State have a variety of tax exemptions and abatements that can benefit taxpayers. Read on...

  10. Public invited to attend Aug. 11 meeting for input on homelessness

    The feedback is being sought by the City's Advisory Committee on Homelessness. Learn more...
